login.welcomeDesc: A calm, encrypted control plane for files you need to trust at a glance
login.joinDesc: Create your account and set up the trust-first vault experience
login.feature2: One PIN after setup for normal owner flows
login.passwordHint: Use your account password to enter and finish setup.
login.passwordHintSub: Once your PIN is enrolled, {{product}} can reuse that trust across the vault, secure links, and protected handoffs.
login.pinHint: Use your 4-digit PIN when your trusted owner session is already set up.
login.pinHintSub: Your PIN unlocks the owner trust path without reintroducing normal per-action friction.
login.lockoutMessage: Too many attempts. Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before trying again.
login.lockoutWarning: This pause protects your account from repeated sign-in attempts. Wait for the timer, then try again or use account recovery if you no longer have the right credential.
login.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are unavailable in this browser. Enter your PIN to continue.
login.passkeyCanceled: The passkey prompt was canceled. Enter your PIN to continue.
login.passkeyFailed: Passkey unlock failed. Enter your PIN to continue.
login.passkeyNeedsEmail: Enter your email first, then try the passkey again.

forcePassword.title: Password Change Required
forcePassword.description: Your administrator has required you to set a new password before you can continue.
forcePassword.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
forcePassword.tooLong: New password must be 72 bytes or fewer
forcePassword.mustDiffer: New password must be different from current password
forcePassword.keyUnlockFailed: We could not unlock your account key with the current password. Your password was not changed. Sign out and try again, or start account recovery.
forcePassword.previousEnvelope: Previous password (only if an administrator reset your login)
forcePassword.previousEnvelopeHelp: This stays in your browser and is used only to unlock your existing account key.
